field.label: Enable
field.help: Send Unbound's root-zone queries through the gateway group's best member to that member's resolver (its row under Per-member resolvers, else the Default resolver below), and fall back to Unbound's own forwarders when no member is usable. Off returns Unbound to its own forwarders and removes the resolvers' routes.

field.label: Dry run
field.help: Decide and log only: Unbound's forwarders and the resolvers' routes are left alone. The block and pass rules are still loaded.

field.label: Gateway group
field.help: The saved gateway group, all of one address family, whose members are the tunnels to the resolver. Every member must be monitored.

field.label: Default resolver
field.help: The resolver's address inside the tunnels, used by every member without its own below. IPv4 or IPv6.

field.label: Failback delay (seconds)
field.help: How long a better member must stay usable before Unbound returns to it, from 60 to 3600 seconds. Use at least the longest monitor period of the members.

field.label: Probe name
field.help: The name used to check that the resolver answers; "." asks for the root.

field.label: Notify on switch
field.help: POST each switch between a member and the fallback to the URL below as JSON, for example to a Home Assistant webhook.

field.label: Notify URL
field.help: The http or https URL that receives each switch.
